"shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request"
E&O of USD 2,000,000 exceeds the USD 1M fallback floor
cyber of USD 5,000,000 exceeds the USD 2M fallback floor

reasons: All six preferred atomic elements (CGL per-occurrence and aggregate limits, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) are expressly present in the inserted paragraph; the locked preferred level is complete.
The insertion is appropriate because no insurance provision existed anywhere in the document, and a concise insertion for an absent clause can be minimal.

Minimality is narrowly missed: the drafter added a one-year post-termination coverage tail ("and for one (1) year thereafter"), which the preferred position does not require. This is customer-favourable and low impact, but it is more than needed to complete the selected level.
"at its own expense" is ordinary connective phrasing tied to the maintenance duty and is not treated as offending surplus.

Intent is preserved: the surrounding data-security clause (iii) and General Provisions (i) are untouched, no defined term is contradicted, and "Term"/"Law" track the Agreement's existing usage without creating a dangling mechanic.
